name: IsMaskTooSmallValidator
description: Checks that an encoded iris template retains enough unmasked feature bits for reliable matching.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Pydantic IRIS algorithm parameters and data models
metadata.overlap: A separately callable IRIS algorithm or subsystem. Compose through the package's IRImage/GeometryPolygons/IrisTemplate contracts; types, callbacks and mathematical helpers are shared dependencies. This is biometric processing, not a complete authorized identity service.
metadata.data_sensitivity: Biometric images, iris templates and derived measurements; protect inputs, traces and outputs.
